html_source: Detail from a Bartholomew map of Dublin showing the GPO's location between Henry Street and Prince's Street (unnamed on map) and its proximity to Eden Quay. Butt Bridge swiveled, allowing ships to proceed upriver as far as the O'Connell bridge. Source: Pierce, James Joyce's Ireland.

search_text.text:
Detail from a Bartholomew map of Dublin showing
  the GPO's location between Henry Street and Prince's Street
  (unnamed on map) and its proximity to Eden Quay. Butt Bridge
  swiveled, allowing ships to proceed upriver as far as the
  O'Connell bridge. Source: Pierce, James Joyce's Ireland.

title: POMap
